citations.claim: at first violating step 1 the body has moved under the over-limit force
initial state at rest before violation

counterfactual.change: set controller noise 1 -> 0; nominal command is then clamped to fmax so no violation

explanation: With kp=100, vcmd=20, nominal velocity-error force saturates at fmax=5, but seeded sensor noise=1 adds after clamping, producing 6.5 at step 1 (limit 5.0). Removing noise removes the excess, so the clamp is bypassed by post-clamp noise injection.
vision_note: A red controller-driven body sits on the left side of the arena with a distant green waypoint cross on the right. Between step 0 and step 1 the body shows essentially no visible displacement.
